_comment: Registry for the agentic-workflow kit sync (distribute_kit.py). The canonical source is kriegerdataforge-cicd/kit/common/. 'files' are the byte-identical, language-agnostic kit paths synced to every repo in 'repos'. check mode reports drift; distribute mode opens one PR per drifted repo (never auto-merges). See ADR D-001 / kriegerdataforge/docs/epics/agent-kit-distribution.md.
_excluded_notes: kriegerdataforge-cicd is the SOURCE — its own kit/common IS the canonical, so it is not a sync target (no self-PRs). The two reports-ecosystem package repos (kriegerdataforge-reports-sdk, kriegerdataforge-report-form) joined at epic W2.5 — both were generated from the templates with kit v1.3.0 aboard, so they enter in-sync and simply ride future Distributes. The 4 kriegerdataforge-template-* repos ARE included (epic slice P2 complete: committed + is_template): keeping them in sync here means a /generate'd repo is born current, so no kit-injection is needed in issue-create-repo.yml. kriegerdataforge-fmt joined on 2026-09-29 (ADR D-029): it carried kit v1.3.0 by hand, its version check is the central check_version.py, so its kit sync PRs are exempt like everyone's, and it sits on the Platform board. .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md is intentionally NOT in 'files' (per-repo by ADR D-002; the synced docs/agent/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md is the canonical DoD). AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / .cursorrules / .github/copilot-instructions.md are per-repo and never synced, except that since ADR D-046 the sync inserts one line into AGENTS.md, the ecosystem context pointer, when it is absent, and touches nothing else there, and since ADR D-047 it sets open-pull-requests-limit 0 on every updates entry of .github/dependabot.yml when the repo has one. Every change a kit sync makes is a kit copy or one of those two lines, so its commits carry [skip ci] and the sync PR runs no CI (ADR D-047). A kit sync PR is docs-only; each repo's version-check skips it because the central scripts/common/check_version.py exempts kit-only PRs (ADR D-001 option B) — the same registry-derived exemption also covers the dev-script sync PRs of scripts_registry.json (ADR D-013).
